name: Lateral Thinking Provocations: Escape Principle (Po)
sprint: Identify an indispensable system component. Declare: "Po: [Component] does not exist." Conceive two functional configurations that achieve the system's objective without that component.
mechanism: Negates an axiomatic system property ("Po: Component X does not exist"), forcing working memory to construct alternative functional pathways.
questions: Po: The web platform maintains no centralized database; where does authoritative state live?
Po: The client hardware transmits zero data packets to the backend; how does coordination occur?
Po: The software contains zero conditional branch statements; how is logic evaluated?
example: Collaborative Workspace Synchronization. "Po: The distributed application contains no central database server." Breakthrough: The architecture migrates from client-server relational storage to Conflict-free Replicated Data Types (CRDTs) over WebRTC mesh connections, enabling local mutation and deterministic peer-to-peer merge operations without a centralized persistence cluster.
